headline: **MLB Daily Roundup: July 11, 2026**
article:
The Philadelphia Phillies suffered a 10-2 loss to the Detroit Tigers, while the New York Yankees secured a 5-3 victory over the Washington Nationals. The Kansas City Royals fell to the Baltimore Orioles 3-5, and the Chicago Cubs were shut out by the Cincinnati Reds 0-4. The San Francisco Giants placed Victor Bericoto on the 10-day injured list due to a left oblique strain.

Several players have been affected by injuries, impacting their teams' lineups. Victor Bericoto (San Francisco Giants) is out with a left oblique strain, while Mick Abel (Minnesota Twins) has been placed on the 60-day injured list due to right elbow inflammation. Zack Gelof (Athletics) is on the 10-day injured list with a right knee laceration, and Mark Vientos (New York Mets) has been placed on the 10-day injured list with a right hand fracture.

The Chicago White Sox have bolstered their pitching staff with the acquisition of LHP Jaden Woods in a trade with the Pittsburgh Pirates. The White Sox sent LHP Brandon Eisert and 1B Jacob Gonzalez to the Pirates in exchange for Woods and future considerations.

top_news.title: **Phillies Suffer 10-2 Loss to Tigers**
top_news.summary: The Philadelphia Phillies fell short in a lopsided matchup against the Detroit Tigers, ultimately losing 10-2. Aaron Nola led the Phillies' pitching effort, throwing 5.0 innings with 8 strikeouts and 2 earned runs.

top_news.title: **Yankees Take Down Nationals 5-3**
top_news.summary: The New York Yankees secured a 5-3 victory over the Washington Nationals in their latest matchup. James Wood led the Nationals' offense with a 3-hit, 1-home run performance.

top_news.title: **Royals Fall to Orioles in 3-5 Showdown**
top_news.summary: The Kansas City Royals dropped a tough game to the Baltimore Orioles, ultimately falling 3-5. Samuel Basallo led the Royals' offense with a home run and 2 RBI.

top_news.title: **Cubs Fall to Reds in Shutout**
top_news.summary: The Chicago Cubs suffered a 0-4 loss to the Cincinnati Reds, marking a tough outing for the Cubs. JJ Bleday led the Cubs' offense with a home run and 2 RBIs, while Hunter Greene dominated on the mound for the Reds, striking out 12 batters in 7 innings.

top_news.title: **Giants Place Victor Bericoto on 10-Day Injured List**
top_news.summary: San Francisco Giants right fielder Victor Bericoto has been placed on the 10-day injured list due to a left oblique strain. The injury occurred on July 10, 2026.

top_news.title: **White Sox Acquire LHP Jaden Woods in Trade**
top_news.summary: The Chicago White Sox have made a move to bolster their pitching staff, trading LHP Brandon Eisert and 1B Jacob Gonzalez to the Pittsburgh Pirates for LHP Jaden Woods and future considerations. The trade was announced on July 11, 2026.
